Plot iSNV frequency spectrum

Source: R/visualization.R
plotFrequencySpectrum.Rd

Creates a publication-quality histogram or density plot of alternative allele frequencies, optionally faceted by sample or metadata group. Only calls are drawn: a recorded frequency of 0 is a site assessed without the allele and is left out. A site at frequency 1 is drawn unless QC has removed it.

Usage

plotFrequencySpectrum(
  whe,
  type = c("histogram", "density"),
  facetBy = NULL,
  usePassedOnly = TRUE,
  threshold = NULL,
  freqRange = NULL
)

Arguments

whe

A WithinHostExperiment.

type

Character. "histogram" (default) or "density".

facetBy

Character (optional). Column name in colData to facet by.

usePassedOnly

Logical. Only show QC-passed variants (default: TRUE).

threshold

Numeric scalar (optional). Variant calling threshold to display as reference line. Default NULL (no line shown). Set to e.g. 0.03 for a 3% threshold.

freqRange

Numeric vector of length 2 (optional). Frequency range for the x-axis as proportions, e.g. c(0, 0.5). Default NULL uses the data range.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    vcf <- system.file("extdata", "test_donor.vcf",
        package = "WithinHostExperiment")
    whe <- readWithinHost(vcf,
        colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(sample_id = "d"),
        caller = "ivar")
    plotFrequencySpectrum(whe, threshold = 0.03)
}
